entities.summary: The Malabar Independent Syrian Church (MISC), also known as the Thozhiyur Church, is a Independent Oriental Orthodox church centred in Kerala, India. It is one of the churches of the Saint Thomas Christian community, which traces its origins to the evangelical activity of Thomas the Apostle in the 1st century.
